tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall furnish satisfactory material supply completion certificate signed by the competent authority or copy of invoices/s or any other documentary evidence for materials supplied for the order.

Bidder shall have successfully executed at least one order (Rate Contract Letter of Award or Purchase Order) for supply of office stationeries in State/Central Govt./PSUs/Autonomous bodies with order value not less than Rs.8.12 lakh in a single order dated during the previous five financial years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26). Bidder shall furnish one order copy with order value not less than Rs.8.12 lakh in a single order.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Rate Contract Letter of Award or Purchase Order

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have an average annual turnover of Rs.16.24 lakh in any two financial years during the previous five financial years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26). Bidder shall furnish annual financial turnover certificate mentioning UDIN (Unique Document Identification No) duly signed by Chartered Accountant.
